result.title: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
result.summary: 3D generation, editing, and completion are typically treated as regenerating the complete 3D asset under task-specific constraints, even when only a local region needs modification. This leads to task isolation, inconsistency in content that should remain unchanged, and dependence on task-specific paired data. We address these issues with a key observation: the three tasks all synthesize a designated region while keeping the rest intact---the full region for generation, the target region for editing, and the missing region for completion. We term this paradigm Selective Modeling and build SeMo3D upon it; it naturally unifies the three tasks, preserves unchanged content by construction, and enables training without paired editing or completion data, since any 3D asset can be partitioned into a selected region and its context. For training, we propose region-selective denoising, which randomly selects regions of varying sizes on standard 3D assets and applies noise and loss only to them, jointly learning all three tasks. For architecture, we propose Omni3DiT, a multi-condition 3D diffusion transformer that distinguishes regions to create from those to retain and fuses image, text, and point guidance for fine-grained control. Experiments across three benchmarks show SeMo3D surpasses state-of-the-art methods on all tasks, delivering multimodal controllability in generation and strong consistency and accuracy in editing and completion. SeMo3D further serves as a unified modeling tool for agents, enabling efficient 3D creation through natural-language interaction. Project page: https://xiaokunsun.github.io/SeMo3D.github.io/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SeMo3D，把 3D 生成、编辑与补全统一为「选择性建模」：仅对指定区域加噪并计算损失（region-selective denoising），并以多条件扩散 transformer Omni3DiT 融合图像、文本与点云引导。
AI.relevance_reason: 「只更新选定区域、其余保持不变」的加噪与监督方式，可能为 latent 状态的局部更新、掩码式部分监督提供可核查线索，但与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关联。
